sentence: This project builds data services that help environmental health researchers collect, store, analyze and combine biological and chemical data.
This project tests an optical imaging method that predicts how likely triple negative breast cancer is to progress.
This project studies whether neurons in the basolateral amygdala can be treatment targets in a non-human primate model of extreme anxiety.
This project helps scientists study blood diseases by giving them access to emerging technologies.
This project buys a sequencing and spatial multiomics system to replace an outdated sequencing system.
This project builds a platform that carries impermeable drug molecules into cells so they can be screened in cell-based assays.
This project studies how mobile DNA elements called retrotransposons affect myeloid leukemia.
This project studies how injury to blood vessel cells leads to organ damage in children with sepsis.
This project tests whether navigation strategies help women get breast and colorectal cancer screening and genetic testing.
This project uses a small polymer to deliver an inhibitor to brain tumors in animal tumor models.
This project builds a mass spectrometry method that maps how lipids interact with proteins.
This project supports research on the metabolic aspects of various disease states.
This project studies how exercise by mothers with obesity decreases obesity risk in infants, using human umbilical-cord mesenchymal stem cells.
This project builds a machine learning tool that finds which alternative splicing events in cancer are directly controlled by splicing factors.
This project builds a wearable electronic system that gives diagnostic information about whole person health.
This project studies stem cell biology and neuroscience to find treatments for human neurological disorders.
This project looks for ways to reduce cancer risk using drugs, behavioral interventions and screening.
This project supplies wild-type and genetically engineered pigs to study how immunity affects airborne influenza transmission.
This project builds tools to develop female-killing technologies in mosquitoes.
This project uses artificial intelligence to predict clinical outcomes of psychosis from electronic health records and genetic information.
